newsitem.title: UK: ANALYSTS LOWER FULL YEAR ESTIMATES ON RANK.
newsitem.headline: ANALYSTS LOWER FULL YEAR ESTIMATES ON RANK.

text.p: British leisure group Rank Group Plc is now expected to report lower profits before tax at the full year, after a disappointing set of half year figures, said analysts on Thursday.
Fraser Ramzan, an analyst at Lehman Brothers, said he was shaving 10 million off his forecast for the full year to an estimated 306 million profit before tax.
Dresdner Kleinwort Benson said it was taking its forecast down to 315 million stg from 335 million for the full year.

Earlier the group reported a larger than expected 12 million stg drop to 87 million stg in its pre-tax, pre-exceptional profits for the six months ended June 30. Analysts had forecast profits of around 93 million.
Analysts said the results showed up weak sales of duplication videos in the United States, lower earnings from its casinos and relatively weak like-for-like sales at the Hard Rock cafe chain.
Rank shares were down 20-1/2 pence at 348p at 1230 GMT.
